headline: Seoul Villas and Officetels Become Burdens, Flooding Auctions
summary: Seoul villas and officetels are increasingly going to auction despite government efforts to promote non-apartment supply. Jiji Auction data cited in the report shows the trend.
why: Seoul's housing market is a major driver of household wealth and bank lending in South Korea, and forced auctions signal stress in property financing.
